findings.failureScenario: dc:creator is an ordered rdf:Seq of creators. parse_xmp joins every entry into one string ("Alice; Bob") and write_xmp_lc writes Metadata.artist back as a single rdf:li. Because Ember's sidecar merge owns dc:creator (always replaced on save), a sidecar from another app with creators [Alice, Bob] is rewritten on Ember's next save as one creator "Alice; Bob", even when the user never edited the artist. Other readers then see one creator whose name contains a semicolon.
findings.action: Keep the creator list structured (e.g. a Vec in Metadata), or split artist on the same "; " separator when writing so that read and write are inverses.
